contexts.text: Timnath () = a state of consulting for the Church. This is signified by Timnath also in . The woman whom Samson took from the daughters of the Philistines = truth from what is not good, thus truth obscured. Timnath is also mentioned among the places of inheritance of the tribe of Dan ().
On the way to Timnath () = for the use of the Church; for Timnath = a state of consulting for the Church.
